title: Mohdel curated.json
description: Schema for ~/.config/mohdel/curated.json — see docs/CATALOG.md for the full reference.

propertyNames.description: Model id in the form '<provider>/<model>'. Underscore-prefixed keys (like '_comment') are allowed for inline notes.

oneOf.description: Inline comment value for underscore-prefixed keys.

deprecatedStub.description: Redirect from a retired model id to its replacement.

modelEntry.description: A real model entry. 'model', 'creator', and 'inputFormat' are required.

model.description: Literal model id sent to the provider's API.

baseURL.description: local/ entries only: the OpenAI-compatible server this model is served from (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1). Required there, rejected elsewhere.

provider.description: Routing provider. Defaults to the provider segment of the catalog key.

sdk.description: SDK adapter to use (some providers require this).

type.description: 'model' for chat/completion, 'image' for image generation, 'transcription' for speech-to-text.

description.description: Free-text note about the model, for your own reference.

version.description: Provider-side version or snapshot label, when the provider publishes one.

createdAt.description: Release timestamp reported by the provider.

inputPrice.description: USD per 1M input tokens. Object form is for tiered pricing — must include a 'default' key.

thinkingPrice.description: USD per 1M thinking/reasoning tokens (when the provider bills these separately).

cacheWritePrice.description: USD per 1M tokens written to provider-side prompt cache. Object form is tiered on input tokens.

cacheWrite1hPrice.description: USD per 1M tokens written with a 1h TTL, when the provider prices that above the default write rate. Falls back to cacheWritePrice.

cacheReadPrice.description: USD per 1M tokens served from provider-side prompt cache. Object form is tiered on input tokens.

inputCeilingMargin.description: Tokens held back from contextTokenLimit when sizing an input, for a model whose usable window is smaller than the published one. Subtracted by effectiveContextLimit().

thinkingTokenLimit.description: Maximum thinking tokens per call (when separate from output).

thinkingEffortLevels.description: Map effort name → provider-native thinking budget, or null to disable thinking. Standard names: low/medium/high/xhigh/max/none.

oneOf.description: Map effort name → provider-native budget. Standard names: low/medium/high/xhigh/max/none.

defaultThinkingEffort.description: Effort level used when the envelope omits 'outputEffort'.

speeds.description: Service speed lanes this model sells, keyed by lane name. A lane is a provider request parameter buying a different speed/price point for the same weights. There is no default lane: omitting 'speed' on the envelope sends no parameter. Only lanes declared here may be requested, and only names the provider's adapter accepts.

additionalProperties.description: Lane overlay: the price and rate-limit fields that differ from the base entry. Unnamed fields fall through. Lane names come from the provider's own vocabulary (OpenAI: fast, priority, flex, scale) — the adapter decides how a name reaches the wire.

tags.description: Free-form classification tags (used by 'mo bench --tag', 'mo rank', and caller-side selection).

aliases.description: Alternative ids that should resolve to this entry.

replaces.description: Older model ids this one supersedes.

supportsTools.description: Set false to mark a model as tool-less.

outputCapStrategy.description: What this model does when max_tokens exceeds outputTokenLimit: 'error' rejects the call, 'accept' silently serves less. Informational — overrides the provider-level default for embedders building their own requests; mohdel caps the budget either way.

reasoningContentPlaceholder.description: Filler text sent in place of an empty assistant reasoning turn, for OpenAI-compatible providers that reject one. Read by the chat-completions adapter.

source.description: URL the prices and limits in this entry were read from.

sourcedAt.description: Date the 'source' page was last read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

imageDefaultSize.description: Default size when envelope omits one (e.g. '1024x1024').

transcriptionPrice.description: USD per audio minute (transcription-type entries). Token-billed transcription models (OpenAI gpt-4o-*-transcribe) use inputPrice/outputPrice instead.

embeddingPrice.description: USD per 1,000,000 input tokens for an embedding model. Without it, cost is 0 on every embed call.

dimensions.description: Native width of the vectors this model returns.

dimensionsSelectable.description: Whether the model accepts a requested output width. Providers spell the parameter differently (dimensions, output_dimension, outputDimensionality) and support it on some models only; when false, passing `dimensions` fails before dispatch instead of being ignored.

maxBatch.description: Inputs accepted in one embed call. 2048 on OpenAI, 96 on Cohere, 10 on Qwen Cloud, 1 for Gemini's single-content endpoint. A larger batch fails before dispatch; mohdel does not split one, because splitting changes cost attribution and result ordering.

maxInputTokens.description: Token ceiling for a single input, not for the request.

inputTypes.description: Maps mohdel's symbolic roles (query, document, classification, clustering) to the provider's own vocabulary, e.g. {"query": "RETRIEVAL_QUERY"} for Gemini or {"query": "search_query"} for Cohere. An entry without it rejects `inputType` rather than dropping it: the role is baked into the vector, so a silent drop produces quietly worse retrieval.

defaultInputType.description: Symbolic role sent when the caller names none. Required for providers that make the parameter mandatory (Cohere v3+).

rpmLimit.description: Requests per minute this key may send. Overrides the provider-level default.

tpmLimit.description: Tokens per minute this key may spend. Overrides the provider-level default.

inpmLimit.description: Inputs per minute this key may send to an embedding endpoint, for a provider that meters the endpoint in inputs rather than requests or tokens (Cohere publishes '2,000 inputs / min'). Counted exactly before dispatch from the batch size; a batch larger than the whole allowance is sent rather than delayed, since waiting cannot make it fit.

rateLimitScope.description: Whose budget this key's calls draw on: 'model' = a private bucket for this entry, 'provider' = the pool shared with every other model of the provider.

deprecated.description: Replacement catalog key. An entry carrying this field is a redirect stub and holds no other fields.

suspended.description: Reason this model is temporarily disabled.
